note:
FEATURE / ARCHITECTURE / SHOWCASE: Turn the existing `Assets/Scenes/HouseShowcase.unity` into the canonical shared production integration and visual-review surface for procedural voxel architecture. This foundation is intended to be consumed by later per-town Mounting Force architecture SceneIssues after the town art-direction source of truth is available. It may proceed in parallel with that art-direction work and must not invent or lock final town-specific art.

BASELINE: `HouseShowcase` already exercises multiple generated house configurations and interior switching. Inspect and extend the existing production generation/configuration path rather than replacing it. The showcase is an integration consumer only; authoritative procedural architecture, materials, textures, SDF presentation descriptors, voxel occupancy, collision, and reusable configuration belong in the owning production modules. Follow `AGENTS.md`, `SceneIssues/README.md`, and `SceneIssues/feature-readme.md`, including module-local validation ownership.

REQUIRED SHARED CONTRACT: Future town issues must be able to register/select a semantic town/style profile, semantic structure archetype, deterministic seed, and explicit generation parameters without adding scene-specific coordinate hacks, magic IDs, or one-off geometry. Preserve and extend useful existing house parameters as needed. The contract must be capable of supporting ordinary residences plus later shop, inn, church, warehouse, civic, castle/landmark, and similar structure providers without forcing every archetype through one inappropriate geometry implementation. Parameters should cover the reusable architectural dimensions actually needed by production generation, including footprint/proportions, storey count and floor height, roof/gable form, openings, foundations, trim/details, and other demonstrated requirements.

PRODUCTION VOXEL REALIZATION: A showcased structure must be built from the same authoritative voxel data and production realization path used by the game. Geometry must include the actual voxels that define the structure, material assignments, signed-distance-function/presentation data required for curved surfaces, source textures, and those textures visibly applied through the production material/rendering path. Doors, windows, roofs, floors, stairs, foundations, correct scale, collision/traversal, and interior shell/circulation are part of the structure contract. Collision/world truth must continue to derive from discrete voxel occupancy; curvature remains presentation. Do not introduce arbitrary imported static meshes or a parallel renderer/material/texture/SDF authority.

DETERMINISM AND VARIATION: The same semantic profile + archetype + seed + parameter set must reproduce the same authoritative structure. Different seeds must create meaningful architectural variation rather than cosmetic noise while remaining within the selected style/configuration constraints. Prove the foundation with at least one existing production procedural structure archetype using one canonical review seed/configuration plus at least three additional seeds. All four variants must remain structurally valid, correctly scaled, and navigable where applicable.

HOUSE SHOWCASE UX: Update the existing HouseShowcase so a reviewer can select town/style profile, structure archetype/provider, seed, and supported parameters; regenerate deterministically; and inspect the exterior and interior. Provide deterministic exterior review poses and an interior/player inspection mode sufficient to verify that entrances, doors, windows, floors, stairs, storeys, ceiling heights, and circulation are usable. Furniture and decorative prop dressing are explicitly out of scope for this feature.

REFERENCE-COMPARISON FOUNDATION: Add a reusable data-driven way to associate a canonical structure configuration with one or more concept/reference images and deterministic review camera poses. The built-player review path must capture the rendered structure and preserve enough metadata to identify the reference, profile/archetype, seed, parameters/configuration, and camera pose. Provide a reviewer-friendly comparison result (for example a side-by-side reference/runtime review mode or a durable paired comparison artifact) so later town issues can compare final HouseShowcase screenshots directly against their art-direction reference images. Do not use raw pixel similarity as the art acceptance oracle; comparison exists for direct visual review of silhouette/massing, roof form, proportions, openings, material/texture identity, color language, and distinctive architectural details.

VALIDATION: Because this changes player-visible/runtime production behavior, every affected module with meaningful scene behavior must own or update its focused `<Module>/Validation/` built-player scene and scenario using the real production authoring/generation/rendering/material path; the top-level HouseShowcase alone does not satisfy module-local validation. Update the HouseShowcase player scenario as integration evidence to exercise deterministic regeneration, seed/config switching, exterior capture, interior inspection, and reference-comparison capture. Add focused behavioral tests for deterministic same-input generation, meaningful seed variation, configuration/registration reuse boundaries, and any material/SDF/texture invariants that can be asserted behaviorally. Do not weaken repository budgets or substitute test-only geometry/material stacks.

ACCEPTANCE: (1) HouseShowcase uses the existing production procedural architecture path and becomes a semantic/config-driven integration surface rather than an authority; (2) future town/style profiles and structure providers can register without editing scene-specific hard-coded selection logic; (3) reviewer controls cover profile, archetype/provider, seed, supported parameters, deterministic regeneration, exterior inspection, and interior/player inspection; (4) same input reproduces the same authoritative structure and at least four seeds of one existing production archetype prove nontrivial variation while retaining valid openings/floors/stairs/interiors; (5) production materials, textures, and SDF-based curved presentation are supported end-to-end and visibly applied to the showcased production voxels; (6) doors/windows/floors/stairs/foundations/scale/collision/traversal remain production-compatible and the representative interior is actually walkable; (7) a data-driven reference-image + deterministic review-pose contract exists and built-player evidence produces durable reference/runtime comparison suitable for later art review; (8) module-local built-player validation plus HouseShowcase integration evidence are green and final durable screenshots are inspected directly; (9) a concise extension note documents how a later town SceneIssue supplies a town/style profile, structure provider/archetype, seed/parameters, materials/textures/SDF data, and concept-reference comparison without creating a parallel architecture system; (10) no final Mounting Force town-specific art, furniture/prop dressing, or final world placement is required by this foundation.

DEPENDENCY BOUNDARY: This foundation does not wait for the Mounting Force town art-direction feature. Later per-town implementation issues should depend on both this completed foundation and the completed art-direction source-of-truth package before final town buildings are implemented.
resolutionSummary: Added the shared semantic procedural-architecture profile/provider/config/review foundation, adapted the existing guild-house production path as the first provider, repaired multi-storey circulation and production window/SDF authoring, refactored HouseShowcase into a registry-driven reviewer surface, added Structures and Showcase module-local built-player validations plus reference metadata and extension documentation, and directly inspected the final built-player evidence. Four deterministic seeds, explicit configuration/profile switching, production materials/textures/SDF presentation, real Glass openings, occupancy-backed stairs, and walkable interior clearance are verified through production paths.
